description: This Java class defines FDroidServiceInfo, a Parcelable extension of ServiceInfoImpl used for Android service discovery, serialization, and deserialization, including handling of network addresses and service properties.

classes.name: FDroidServiceInfo
classes.description: A Parcelable class for Android service info with network address handling and custom properties.

methods.name: getFingerprint
methods.description: Returns the fingerprint string from service properties, or null if not set.

methods.name: getRepoAddress
methods.description: Returns the service URL, including the 'path' property if present.

methods.name: readBytes
methods.description: Reads a byte array from a Parcel.

methods.name: FDroidServiceInfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object from a Parcel, reading service properties and network addresses.

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Serializes the object into a Parcel, including service properties and network addresses.
